Vodka sauce rose to prominence in Italy and the United States around the 1970s–80s; this rich rigatoni form is especially at home in Italian-American restaurant cooking. Vodka is functional, not decorative: it deglazes caramelized tomato paste and helps bridge tomato and dairy, but must be reduced before cream.
